aimed_volley.label: Aimed Volley
aimed_volley.note: Everything stops but the reticle. For a few seconds the shots go where they are pointed.

evasive_burn.label: Evasive Burn
evasive_burn.note: Throttle up and refuse to be where the last volley was aimed.

sensor_sweep.label: Sensor Sweep
sensor_sweep.note: Everything the dish can reach, lit up at once — and everything looking back knows it.

coolant_flush.label: Coolant Flush
coolant_flush.note: Dump the reserve through the loop. Buys one more alpha, and there is no second bottle.

brace.label: Brace
brace.note: Set the feet, drop the shoulder, and take it. Nothing shifts this for a while.

steady_aim.label: Steady Aim
steady_aim.note: The pilot settles, breathes out, and shoots like the range officer taught them.
